test_title: PYST 42: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 2nd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following diagram, the hexagon stands for 'boys', the rectangle stands for 'sportspersons', and the triangle stands for 'musicians'. The letters given in the different segments represent persons belonging to that category.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47dafb4633e841a3d5edce3bd426d8c9426ad841d6f56fd321d517f293f69973.png] 

Which category is represented by the letter 'f'?

options.text: Musicians who are boys and sportspersons both
Boys who are musicians but not sportspersons
Boys who are sportspersons but not musicians
Sportspersons who are musicians but not boys

solution:
The category represented by the letter 'f' is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09d466d26e397251a86822ad9c364fc96b040b511e20068c70660a8fa68ba6cd.png] 

 

 
• Musicians who are boys and sportspersons both → b
 
• **Boys who are musicians but not sportspersons → f**
 
• Boys who are sportspersons but not musicians → d
 
• Sportspersons who are musicians but not boys → c

Hence, '**Boys who are musicians but not sportspersons**' is the correct answer.
